implementation: Standard PyTorch Tensor operators through torch_npu; no custom kernels
timing: median of synchronized full-query sweeps with resident padded query batches; excludes recall and separate process-HBM sampling sweep
recall: mean overlap with ground-truth top-K divided by K
memory_metric: sampled npu-smi current-process HBM peak; includes resident index, query batches, allocator cache and NPU runtime; separate search sweep, not an instantaneous hardware peak
